main_text.p: Argent. apud Laurent. Pignorium, ponderis 4. drachm. Argent.

In siclis hisce omnium literarum figuræ non habentur, sed tantum 13. scil. ࠀ[?] ࠉ[?] ࠒ[?] ࠕ[?] ࠊ[?] ࠌ[?] ࠐ[?] ࠀ[?] ࠓ[?] ࠊ[?] ࠍ[?] ࠏ[?] ࠎ[?] ex quarum tamen cum hodiernis Samaritanis convenientia de reliquis judicare licet.

Ex his ࠀ[?] et ࠌ[?] magis à nostris differre videntur, ࠕ[?] minus, reliquæ parum vel nihil. Conjiciunt alii præter has quatuor alias ex hisce siclis, scil. v ࠈ[?] ࠑ[?] ࠕ[?] In sexta enim figura v ex una parte, & ex altera Tau instar crucis repræsentatur; at ࠊ[?] & ࠑ[?] obscuriores.

Literam vero Tau crucis figuram repræsentâsse, prout affirmantOrigines et Hieronym in Ezech.etiam ex hodierno Tau Samaritano sic colligit Morinus. Ut enim ex Aleph nostro Samaritano, si unam lineolam ex latere dextro tollas fit figura Tau, sic in siclis 2. & 5. si tol-

page.notes: Two woodcut coin roundels: the left shows a tree with leaves, the right shows a censer or altar with flames. Samaritan letters are rendered with approximate Unicode characters, and each is marked [?] because the scan is too small to confirm them. The thirteen letters after "tantum 13. scil." are only a count from the image. The second line of the Samaritan series may need checking. Printed spacing "affirmantOrigines" and "Ezech.etiam" is left as printed.
